```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library (dplyr)
data(package = "cricketdata")
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
library(cricketdata)
balls <- cricketdata::fetch_cricsheet(
  type = "bbb",
  gender = "male",
  competition = "odis"
)

one_match <- balls |>
  filter(match_id == 1000887)

names(balls)
one_match |> distinct(match_id, start_date, venue, batting_team)
class(balls$match_id); class(balls$start_date)

```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
